conviction_note: The quarter was pre-released as inside information on 2026-10-12. The stock fell 28.8% that day and has since traded flat at 54-58 SEK. So the release carries no news on Q3 revenue or EBIT. What it adds is October/Q4 trading colour, cash flow and the call's view on the >30% growth target. I found no sourced number on any of those, so p_up stays near 50 (52) and abs_move_pct is set at 6. That is above the 3% pre-released base because this name's observed print moves are 4.4/3.6/1.0/15.3/11.7%, realised vol is 107%, and a change to the growth target on the call is a live tail. The findings sum (+0.3) and the scaled number (+0.24) are both small and agree in sign.

new_in_release.expect: unknown. The bar is Redeye's 15-25% growth for the next 2-3 quarters. Q3 ran at 11-12%, so October colour that confirms growth staying near 10% reads negative, and any re-acceleration reads positive. No sourced October data point either way.

The company gives no annual guide. The long-term >30% growth / >80% margin targets were reiterated on 10-12. If the targets are softened on the call, that is the downside tail. A firm reiteration is mostly priced.
Likely strong: operating cash flow was EUR 43.1m in Q2 at an 82-83% EBIT margin. Not expected to surprise.
A buyback is possible: an AGM authorisation to hold up to 10% exists and the stock is down 30%. No sign that one is planned. Unknown.
In line with the pre-release ranges. Expected change approx 0.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue and adjusted EBIT were pre-released as inside information on 2026-10-12, and the stock repriced 28.8% that day, so the reported quarter carries approximately no new information.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The reported-quarter line drove +15.3% on Q1 2026 (a beat) and -11.7% on Q2 2026 despite +31% growth. Both were un-pre-released periods.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The -28.8% gap on 10.9m shares on 10-12, followed by three weeks of flat trading, is what a fully absorbed number looks like.
findings.independence: Redeye realigned its forecasts to the pre-release: https://www.borsvarlden.com/finwire/CRF00F6CE7

findings.finding: Since the warning, Hacksaw has filed a run of distribution wins and new verticals: a B2B prediction-markets platform (10-15), Bally's Intralot UK (10-16) and a Connecticut debut with FanDuel (11-02). The Q3 report and call can frame these as Q4 growth drivers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose 3.9% on 2026-11-02, the day of the FanDuel Connecticut release. Earlier partnership releases moved it little.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Each release is public and 11-02 already gained 3.9%. What is left is any revenue quantification on the call, and nothing sources that.
findings.independence: FanDuel Connecticut release, https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bc5a40227ad2e34da66d47ef56ee62bd0&lang=en&src=listed (same issuer, so weak independence)

findings.finding: Disclosed shorts rose to about 5.3% after the warning and have gone flat (5.34 -> 5.28%). They are held by fast quant or multi-strategy funds (Walleye 0.82%, Citadel 0.70%, PDT 0.63%) who have little reason to stay short past a 'less bad' call. Nordnet retail were the largest net buyers on the crash day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print with a material disclosed short. Shorts reached record levels only after 10-12.
findings.original_quote: Walleye Capital LLC | Hacksaw AB | SE0025138357 | 0,82 | 2026-10-26; Citadel Advisors LLC | 0,7 | 2026-10-22; PDT Partners LLC | 0,63 | 2026-10-12 ('Aktuella positioner' = current positions)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. If the market expected a squeeze, the short would be covering into the print; it is flat. At 5% the position is not crowded fuel, so this is sized small.
findings.independence: efn 2026-10-21, 'blankningen i Hacksaw på ny rekordnivå' (short interest at a new record, 5.1%): https://efn.se/blankningen-i-hacksaw-pa-ny-rekordniva

findings.finding: Evolution's Q3 2026 RNG (slots) revenue grew only 10.1% y/y. That matches Hacksaw's 11-12% and supports 'softer market conditions' as a sector-wide slot softness rather than a one-quarter Hacksaw content miss, which argues against a quick re-acceleration in the Q4 commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 10-12 warning on growth/outlook moved the stock -28.8%, the largest move in its history.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a peer proxy, not a Hacksaw number, and macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis. Also, Redeye's 15-25% next-quarters bar (10-20) was set before Evolution reported. If the market had absorbed the read-through, estimates would sit nearer 10%, and no source shows that.
